sections.label: Dust / the last green
sections.role: establish world, scale, the tiny green light

sections.label: Solitude / counting days
sections.role: introduce the gardener, her routine, her waiting

sections.label: A star falls
sections.role: the ark passes, a pod detaches, hope and fear

sections.label: Recognition
sections.role: the intruder is the boy she lost; she hides him

sections.label: Shelter
sections.role: tending wounds, the two cranes, uneasy peace

sections.label: The visitor's hunger
sections.role: his mission vs her last seed; two losses collide

sections.label: Shared warmth
sections.role: storm repair, touch, the seed opens for both of them

sections.label: The seed wakes
sections.role: growth, joy, then the countdown returns

sections.label: The choice / departure
sections.role: he takes the pod and leaves; she does not stop him

sections.label: Storm / reunion / rebirth
sections.role: betrayal reversed, dome breaks, rain and tree; the film's climax

sections.label: Rain / after
sections.role: resolution, time passing, the world healed; final title

shots.composition: green point on lower third, huge negative sky
shots.action: Nothing moves except ash drifting right-to-left and a faint green pulse at the dome. A dead pylon creaks.
shots.function: establish scale and the single living point
shots.implementation: set_ashwide; cached far/mid layers; 220 dust motes; paper grain

shots.composition: ark crosses the top third; a thin falling line cuts the frame
shots.environment: night sky, ark silhouette, ash clouds
shots.action: The ark's lights crawl like a slow whale. A pod detaches, its ember trail drawing a vertical line toward the cliff.
shots.transition_in: cut on a low piano note
shots.transition_out: match cut: line becomes the window frame
shots.function: introduce the ark and the falling visitor
shots.implementation: set_arksky; ark as layered silhouette + window lights; ember trail shader-ish stroke

shots.composition: dust grain in lower third, hand enters from top
shots.environment: windowsill, macro dust, a green spore
shots.action: A dust grain trembles, splits, reveals a green spore. Mu's fingers enter and cup it; her fingernails are cracked.
shots.function: macro image that makes dust potential life; introduces Mu's hand
shots.implementation: set_macro; particle close-up; soft DOF; hand insert rig

shots.composition: Mu at left third, seedling at right; tall dome ribs
shots.environment: orchard interior, empty pots, hanging lamp
shots.action: Mu waters the seedling with an eyedropper. One drop hangs, falls. She wipes condensation from a leaf.
shots.camera: slow push from MS to MCU
shots.function: introduce Mu, the seedling and the ritual
shots.implementation: set_orchard; mu rig idle/reach; water drop fx; lamp light pool

shots.composition: tally marks fill frame; her hand at bottom
shots.environment: glass wall, chalk tally marks, condensation
shots.action: Her hand adds one mark to 2,190 others. The chalk slips. She steadies it, finishes the mark, presses her palm to the glass.
shots.transition_out: match cut: palm to glass reflection
shots.function: reveal the cost of her waiting without exposition
shots.implementation: set_orchard; tally texture cached; hand rig; chalk particle

shots.composition: profile at left, photograph in frame edge
shots.environment: orchard interior, cracked pane, old photo, paper crane
shots.action: She climbs the ladder, sees the photo tucked in the frame: two children, one paper crane. She almost touches it; the ark's shadow passes.
shots.camera: slow drift right, rack focus from glass to photo
shots.emotion: the boy is a memory, not a stranger
shots.function: plant the photo/crane mystery
shots.implementation: set_orchard; insert photo; crane prop; rack focus via blur layers

shots.composition: dome low, ark huge above, Mu tiny on ladder
shots.environment: orchard interior looking up through dome
shots.action: The ark passes; its shadow sweeps the plants. Every leaf leans toward the light. One leaf detaches and lands on her shoulder.
shots.camera: low angle, slow tilt up, lens flare
shots.function: the ark is both hope and threat
shots.implementation: set_orchard; dome skylight; ark overlay; leaf particle; god rays

shots.composition: Mu centered low, seedling foreground
shots.action: She ties a paper wish to the sapling: a drawing of two cranes. She whispers. The paper trembles in the draft.
shots.camera: slow push to CU on hands
shots.transition_out: whip to exterior on the pod's sonic boom
shots.emotion: her wish is a physical object
shots.function: make the wish concrete before it is interrupted
shots.implementation: set_orchard; mu rig kneel; paper wish; crane drawing; shallow DOF

shots.composition: dome lower right, pod trail upper left
shots.environment: cliff exterior at dusk, storm wall, orchard glow
shots.action: Dusk. The orchard glows. The pod's ember trail grows. Mu runs out of the dome, scarf whipping.
shots.function: launch the inciting event
shots.implementation: set_cliff; dusk palette; mu run cycle; ember trail; wind fx

shots.composition: Mu on cliff edge at left, sky at right
shots.environment: cliff edge, wind, scarf, distant pod
shots.action: She shields her eyes. The pod tumbles, fires a retro-burn, disappears behind the ridge. Her scarf tears free.
shots.emotion: she chooses to move toward the unknown
shots.function: the 'wave/hold/let go' hand motif begins
shots.implementation: set_cliff; mu rig; cloth sim on scarf; smoke; pod sprite

shots.composition: ridge line diagonal, impact at right third
shots.action: Impact. A wall of dust and glass sprays toward camera. Mu drops behind a rock; the lantern goes out.
shots.function: raise the stakes physically
shots.implementation: set_ridge; impact fx; dust wall; debris; camera shake

shots.composition: Mu low left, flame at center, figure far right
shots.action: She relights the lantern. In the dust, a figure crawls from the wreck and collapses. She lifts a pruning hook.
shots.emotion: she chooses to help or hide
shots.function: end act I on a decision
shots.implementation: set_ridge; mu rig; chen collapse rig; lantern light; dust

shots.composition: door frame, two bodies, green interior beyond
shots.action: She drags Chen through the door. His cracked mask hisses. His hand leaves a dark smear on the glass.
shots.emotion: the intruder becomes a body in her care
shots.function: chorus 1 begins with physical action
shots.implementation: set_orchard_door; drag rig; mask prop; smear decal; storm bg

shots.composition: Chen's face lower third, Mu's hands top
shots.environment: orchard floor, mask off, scar, crane
shots.action: She removes the mask. Recognition: the scar through his brow, the paper crane in his collar. Her hands stop.
shots.camera: static CU, rack focus from scar to crane
shots.transition_out: match cut: crane to her eye
shots.emotion: he is the boy she lost
shots.function: the recognition beat; no dialogue
shots.implementation: set_orchard; chen face rig; mask; crane; blink/tear fx

shots.composition: bodies among pots, seedling between them
shots.action: Overhead: she lays him among the pots. The seedling's leaves turn toward him. Her tears fall on his cheek; he does not wake.
shots.function: chorus 1 resolves into shelter, not romance
shots.implementation: set_orchard; overhead composition; two rigs; leaf turn; tear fx

shots.composition: three inserts: wound, cranes, wrist signal
shots.action: Insert 1: she cleans his wound. Insert 2: two paper cranes side by side, one faded. Insert 3: his wrist device blinks red.
shots.function: interlude: quiet labor, plant the countdown
shots.implementation: macro set; texture insets; device UI as diegetic light, no text

shots.composition: dome centered, dawn, tiny green heart
shots.environment: orchard exterior at dawn, ash plain
shots.action: Dawn. The dome is a green heartbeat in the ash. Inside, Mu sleeps sitting up beside Chen. The camera pulls back slowly.
shots.function: breathe; show the fragility of the refuge
shots.implementation: set_cliff_dawn; dome glow; interior silhouette; crane move

shots.composition: Chen at right, pod on table left, red signal
shots.environment: orchard interior, table, seed pod, wrist device
shots.action: Chen wakes. He watches Mu sleep. His hand hovers over the seed pod; the red signal pulses on his wrist.
shots.emotion: his want is real and sympathetic
shots.function: verse 2 begins with temptation
shots.implementation: set_orchard; chen rig; hand insert; pod glow; device light

shots.composition: Mu left, Chen right, pod between; dome ribs
shots.action: Mu wakes and catches his hand at the pod. They confront: he points to the sky, she points to the last green. Neither backs down.
shots.camera: handheld two-shot, slow orbit to profile
shots.function: the argument that defines the middle
shots.implementation: set_orchard; two rigs; IK hands; pod; orbit camera

shots.composition: device screen left, soil right, faces above
shots.environment: orchard, dead ark gardens on device, mother's ashes in soil
shots.action: He shows her the ark's dead gardens: rows of dust. She opens the vial of her mother's ashes and lets a little fall into the seed bed.
shots.function: make the conflict structural, not moral
shots.implementation: set_orchard; device UI (no text, only dead gardens); ash vial; macro soil

shots.composition: two figures at opposite edges, seedling center
shots.environment: orchard, cold night, crack in dome
shots.action: They sit apart. Ash falls through a crack. She puts a blanket over him; he does not look at her. The seed glows faintly between them.
shots.function: quiet before the storm; show care without words
shots.implementation: set_orchard_night; two rigs; ash through crack; blanket; low light

shots.composition: dome left, storm wall right, two figures on roof
shots.action: The storm hits. A pane cracks. They climb the dome in rain and ash; she holds a pane, he seals it with resin.
shots.function: music lift becomes physical effort
shots.implementation: set_dome_storm; two rigs climb; rain/ash; lightning; wind cloth

shots.composition: beam diagonal, bodies below, pod at edge
shots.environment: orchard interior, collapsing beam, seed pod
shots.action: A support beam snaps. Chen shields Mu; they fall. The seed pod rolls toward the broken edge. Close on her hand grabbing his wrist.
shots.emotion: he protects her before he decides
shots.function: physical intimacy earned through action
shots.implementation: set_orchard_storm; beam rig; fall; pod roll; hand insert

shots.composition: two hands on pod, root between fingers
shots.environment: orchard floor, wet glass, seed pod
shots.action: Both hands close on the pod. Their fingers touch. The pod opens; a white root curls around both wrists. The seed drinks.
shots.emotion: the seed's rule: it needs two people
shots.function: the midpoint miracle; visual rule established
shots.implementation: set_orchard; hand rigs; pod open; root growth; bioluminescence

shots.composition: faces close, sprout light below, rain outside
shots.action: Their faces, close, lit from below by the sprout. They laugh/cry. Outside, the storm quiets. Neither lets go.
shots.camera: slow push to two-shot CU, handheld breath
shots.function: emotional high before the bridge
shots.implementation: set_orchard_night; two rigs; sprout glow; rain-on-glass; micro expressions

shots.composition: tree center, two figures small, dome ribs
shots.environment: orchard, young tree, golden sap rain
shots.action: The sprout unfurls into a young tree. Golden sap falls like rain. They work around it, stealing looks at each other.
shots.emotion: chorus 2 = growth and joy (not repeat of chorus 1)
shots.function: the seed answers their care
shots.implementation: set_orchard_tree; tree growth; sap particles; two rigs; warm palette

shots.composition: two palms on trunk, faces in profile
shots.action: They press their palms to the trunk. Light runs up the branches. Their faces are lit; they look at each other.
shots.function: intimate beat inside the spectacle
shots.implementation: set_orchard_tree; palm contact; light propagation; two rigs

shots.composition: Chen's face, red light from below, Mu soft behind
shots.action: The ark's signal turns red. A countdown. Chen's face falls. Mu sees his expression and understands before he speaks.
shots.camera: static CU, rack focus to Mu
shots.function: turn the joy into dread without dialogue
shots.implementation: set_orchard_tree; device light; face rig; rack focus

shots.composition: open door left, Mu small right, night outside
shots.environment: orchard door, night, pod on his back
shots.action: Night. Chen stands in the open door with the seed pod. Mu wakes. She does not stop him. Her hand lowers.
shots.camera: static wide, long hold; wind moves curtains
shots.emotion: he chooses the ark; she lets him choose
shots.function: the bridge is the choice, not a fight
shots.implementation: set_orchard_door_night; two rigs; door light; wind; pod

shots.composition: launch pad right, Mu left, storm behind
shots.action: He runs to the pod. She follows, stops at the pad's edge. He looks back. She is a small figure in the door light. He boards.
shots.function: the lyric 'I won't go' becomes a visual irony
shots.implementation: set_launchpad; run cycles; pod; rain; wind; two rigs

shots.composition: launch trail top, Mu kneeling bottom, tree dim
shots.action: The pod launches. Mu falls to her knees. The young tree dims leaf by leaf. Ash swirls around her.
shots.transition_out: match cut: trail to pod interior
shots.emotion: the betrayal lands on the final chorus
shots.function: largest emotional drop at the chorus start
shots.implementation: set_launchpad; launch fx; mu kneel; tree dim; ash

shots.composition: Chen in pod, empty pod in hands, earth below
shots.action: In the pod, Chen opens the pod: empty. She kept the seed. A single dry leaf in his hand crumbles. He sees the orchard below, small and dark.
shots.transition_out: match cut: window to dome crack
shots.emotion: he chose wrong; she outplayed him with love
shots.function: the twist: the seed was never his to take
shots.implementation: set_pod_interior; chen rig; empty pod; leaf crumble; window view

shots.composition: dome left, storm right, Mu center small
shots.action: The storm tears the dome apart. Mu shields the seedling with her body. Glass shards fly. Lightning turns the frame white.
shots.function: the storm as antagonist; Mu's choice to protect
shots.implementation: set_dome_break; glass shards; wind; mu shield; lightning

shots.composition: pod falling top, orchard below, rain
shots.action: The pod turns back. Chen ejects, falls toward the orchard, a tiny figure against the storm. The ark's lights recede.
shots.transition_out: match cut: falling body to embrace
shots.function: the return begins
shots.implementation: set_skyfall; pod; chen falling rig; storm; ark

shots.composition: two bodies in rain, tree behind, shards
shots.action: Chen crashes through the broken dome, finds Mu, pulls her up. They hold each other. Roots rise around them.
shots.function: the embrace is the emotional center
shots.implementation: set_dome_ruins; two rigs embrace; rain; roots; shards

shots.composition: seed in four hands, root piercing ground
shots.action: The seed in their hands cracks. A root pierces the ground. Golden light runs through the ash. The rain turns silver.
shots.emotion: the seed opens for their choice
shots.function: the rule planted in S24 pays off
shots.implementation: set_dome_ruins; hand rigs; seed open; root; light; rain color shift

shots.composition: tree erupts center, shards orbit, figures below
shots.action: The tree erupts through the dome. Glass shards float like stars. The ark is silhouetted. Their upturned faces are lit.
shots.function: the film's iconic image
shots.implementation: set_tree_birth; procedural tree; shards; god rays; two rigs; rain

shots.composition: valley left, tree right, rain diagonal
shots.environment: ash valley transforming, rain, distant ark
shots.action: Rain falls on the dead valley. Green spreads in a wave from the tree. The ark's lights descend toward the ground.
shots.transition_out: cut on a drop hitting a leaf
shots.function: show the scale of healing without losing the couple
shots.implementation: set_valley_rain; green spread; rain; ark descend; time-lapse hints

shots.composition: two figures under tree, cranes in foreground
shots.action: Under the tree, they hold each other. Two paper cranes are tied to a branch, one old, one new. The rain softens.
shots.camera: slow orbit to profile, rain in bokeh
shots.transition_out: cut on her hand on his chest
shots.emotion: the lyric 'only for the moment of reunion'
shots.function: quiet inside the spectacle
shots.implementation: set_tree_night; two rigs; cranes; rain; warm light

shots.composition: hands clasped, seed between palms, rain
shots.action: Close on their hands: ten fingers interlocked around the empty seed pod. A drop of rain falls between them. Whiteout.
shots.function: deliver the lyric's image without text
shots.implementation: macro hand rig; pod; rain drop; whiteout

shots.composition: tree center, valley, grounded ark
shots.action: Wide: the tree towers over the valley. The broken dome is a ring of glass at its roots. The ark has landed; people walk toward the green.
shots.function: show what their choice changed
shots.implementation: set_valley_day; tree; ark grounded; crowd silhouettes; green

shots.composition: Chen left, Mu right, ark people behind
shots.action: Chen's people come down the ramp. He meets them, then turns back and reaches for Mu. She takes his hand. The crowd parts.
shots.emotion: he is claimed by both worlds and chooses both
shots.function: reunion with the ark, not just the girl
shots.implementation: set_valley_day; crowd silhouettes; two rigs; hand clasp

shots.composition: tree, valley, seasons, new fields
shots.action: Time-lapse: blossoms, fruit, irrigation channels, new trees. The ark becomes a roof, then a hill. The couple plant rows.
shots.emotion: healing is work, not a single miracle
shots.function: the coda earns the ending
shots.implementation: set_valley_timelapse; tree stages; seasonal palette; crowd/field

shots.composition: older couple under tree, cranes, valley
shots.environment: tree, bench, paper cranes, late afternoon
shots.action: Years later. Older Mu and Chen sit under the tree. She leans on him. Two cranes turn slowly above. A child (their daughter?) runs past, out of focus.
shots.emotion: a life, not just a victory
shots.function: the 'ever after' is ordinary and mortal
shots.implementation: set_tree_old; aged rig variants; cranes; child silhouette; warm light

shots.composition: leaf falls into pool; reflection widens
shots.action: A single leaf falls into a pool. Ripples widen; the reflection shows the tree, the two figures, and the ark in the sky. The image settles. Title.
shots.camera: macro static, then slow pull to reflection
shots.emotion: the last image outlasts the song
shots.function: close the circle: dust → seed → leaf → water
shots.implementation: set_pool; leaf; ripples; reflection composite; title type; paper fade
